badEnding: ^While we could never truly know what a failure to communicate the Tsu and Yodo defections may have caused, a conflict between the Imperial forces and their would-be allies would greatly weaken the imperial position, and may allow the Shogunate to claim an early victory over the Imperial Camp.

^The historical capitals of Kyoto and Nara are both wide open to be taken, and while a Shogunate victory is still uncertain, a decisive victory at Toba-Fushimi may lend the their camp more legitimacy, leading to a longer, bloodier war.
